senses.gloss:
जठर a. [जायते जंतुर्गर्भो वास्मिन् जन्-अर
ठांत देशः Tv.]
1 Hard, stiff, firm.
--2
Old.
--3 Bound, tied.
--रः, --रं
1 The
[]
stomach, belly, abdomen; जठरं को
न बिभर्ति केवलं Pt. 1. 22.
--2 The
womb.
--3 A hole, cavity.
--4 The
interior of anything.
--5 The bosom.
--6 Morbid affection of the bowels.
--Comp.
--अग्निः the digestive fire
of the stomach, the gastric fluid.
--आमयः dropsy.
--ज्वाला, --व्यथा
bellyache, colic.
--यंत्रणा, --यातना pain
endured by the child in the womb.

जाठर a. (री f.) [जठरे भवः अण्]
Belonging to or being in the
stomach, stomachic, abdominal;
धनक्षये वर्धति जाठराग्निः Pt. 2. 178.
--रः
1
The digestive faculty, gastric fluid.
--2 ‘Offspring of the womb’, a child.

जठरीकृत a.
1 Contained in the
belly.
--2 Concealed in the bosom.

जठलं Ved. The cavity or
receptacle of waters.
